classification_rules.priority: frozen cap/nail/web; then C0/C1/C2 index-side with live arc proximal of PIP -> index-root; thumb/body side -> anatomical identity unresolved; direct web neighbors -> role review or historical palm anchor
classification_rules.not_homogeneous: INDEX side and THUMB/body side have distinct evidence confidence. No shared-web or palm class is forced into the 32-vertex set.
